base_style: Hand-drawn comic book page on light warm yellow-tan parchment. Bold clean black outlines with selective cross-hatching. Clear, readable panels. Traditional comic illustration, not dense or overly detailed.
characters: Expressive faces with strong black linework. Semi-realistic proportions. Simple clothing folds. Clear silhouettes.
color_palette: Light warm yellow-tan parchment base. Muted earth tones with yellow lighting. Selective bright accents (red, green). Avoid heavy darkness or brown aging.
layout_and_composition: Classic multi-panel comic page on parchment. Black panel borders. Mix of close-ups and wider shots.
lettering_and_dialog: White speech balloons with black outlines and tails. Clean comic lettering. Large jagged hand-drawn sound effects.
text_rendering_guide: Dialogue: Mixed-case in white balloons. Sound Effects: Large jagged lettering with *asterisks*.
